name: Slow N Steady UMD Fall 2024

venue.name: Adele H. Stamp Student Union
venue.address: 3100 Adele H. Stamp Student Union, College Park, MD 20742

information:
This is a 2-day competition, held in **2 different venues**. 
**Saturday**'s events will be held in the main lecture room of [Susquehanna Hall](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jh5QTAQRY8t55D2T6).  **Sunday**'s events will be held in the Grand Ballroom of [Stamp Student Union](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eS1JNDHdzXeUgLfx5). 

Please note, as this is a college venue, there must be parent/guardian supervision for minors for the duration of the competition.
